label: Low-access tract (1 mi)
definition: Share of the residential buffer in tracts flagged low-access to a supermarket at 1 mile. (Result column: LATracts1.)

label: Low-income & low-access tract (1/10 mi)
definition: Share of the residential buffer in tracts flagged low-income and low-access at 1 mile (urban) / 10 miles (rural). (Result column: LILATracts_1And10.)

label: Low-income tract
definition: Share of the residential buffer in tracts meeting the USDA low-income criterion (poverty rate >=20% or median family income below the area threshold). (Result column: LowIncomeTracts.)

label: Low-vehicle-access tract
definition: Share of the residential buffer in tracts where >=100 households have no vehicle and are beyond half a mile from a supermarket. (Result column: HUNVFlag.)
